title: Placed Consumer Accounts Portal Conditions: Recent Payments Counted Against the Portal Debit-Card Ceiling
content:
Payment portal condition for **Placed Consumer Accounts** fixing which recent payments on the account are counted against the portal debit-card ceiling of the day.

## Condition

The payments counted against the portal debit-card ceiling are every card and bank-debit payment received in the last month where one or more credit-card payments were received in the last month and one or more bank-debit payments were received in the last three months; the debit-card and credit-card payments received in the last month where one or more credit-card payments were received in the last month and no bank-debit payment was received in the last three months; and the debit-card payments received in the last month in every other case.

The payments counted are subtracted, at their total, in working out the portal debit-card ceiling.

## The same condition, split out

**Test 1:** Was at least one credit-card payment received on the account in the last month?
**Test 2:** Was at least one ACH bank-debit payment received on the account in the last three months?

| Test 1 | Test 2 | Payments counted, all received in the last month |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Debit-card, credit-card and bank-debit payments |
| Yes | No | Debit-card and credit-card payments |
| No | either | Debit-card payments only |

The payments are the consumer payments posted on the account's money history, sorted by payment channel. A payment is received in the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date from the handling date, a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month; on a handling date of 2026-10-10, the last month begins on 2026-09-11 and the last three months on 2026-07-11.

## Hypothetical worked cases

*Invented payments, handling date 2026-10-10.*

1. Debit card $220.00 (2026-09-29), credit card $480.00 (2026-10-03), bank debit $300.00 (2026-07-15). Test 1 yes, test 2 yes; the bank debit of July is outside the last month, so the total counted is $220.00 plus $480.00, that is $700.00.
2. Debit card $220.00 (2026-09-29), credit card $480.00 (2026-10-03), no bank debit since June. Test 1 yes, test 2 no: $700.00.
3. Debit card $220.00 (2026-09-29), bank debit $300.00 (2026-10-01), no credit card. Test 1 no: $220.00.
4. Credit card $480.00 (2026-10-03) and bank debit $300.00 (2026-10-01), no debit card. Test 1 yes, test 2 yes: $480.00 plus $300.00, that is $780.00.
